stem: Which of the following best explains why Sam refuses to play in the tournament?

options.label: F
options.text: SAM: Yeah, I think so, too.

options.label: G
options.text: SAM: Why? Because I'm a girl?

options.label: H
options.text: SAM: Oh, I don't think so.

options.label: J
options.text: SAM: Well, you wouldn't appreciate my talents. Since I'm a girl and all.
